extmetadata.ImageDescription:
Kenny Barron at Victoria Teater. The concert was part of Oslo Jazzfestival and took place on 13. August 2018 in Oslo.

Lineup: Kenny Barron (piano) Kiyoshi Kitagawa (double bass)

Johnathan Blake (drums)
